name: Nha Trang food guide
summary: Nha Trang’s provincial pages name nem nướng and bún cá from Ninh Hòa, stall food on the Trần Phú night market, and the bowls inside Chợ Đầm and Chợ Xóm Mới. The restaurant names further down are the doors those pages print, not a ranking.
body: Start with the two Ninh Hòa names. Nem nướng is the grilled pork roll. Bún cá is the fish bowl, morning or evening. The night market behind 46 Trần Phú is where the provincial page lists bánh căn without describing it.

The doors further down come from the provincial digital guide, the provincial shopping pages, and Vietnam Tourism. A price from a stall, a blog, or a booking site is not copied here. Where a page names a room and does not describe the food, the note says so.
specialtiesLead: Highlights, in the order the provincial pages support them: nem nướng, bún cá Ninh Hòa, bánh căn, the night-market stalls, the six chè bowls, the Chợ Xóm Mới bowls, and yến sào.
seoTitle: Nha Trang food — nem nướng, bún cá, and the night market
seoDescription: Nha Trang food from the provincial pages: nem nướng and bún cá from Ninh Hòa, the Trần Phú night market, and the restaurant names Khánh Hòa prints.

sections.heading: Specialties
paragraphs: These are the dishes to know by name. Nem nướng is the grilled pork roll from Ninh Hòa. Bún cá is the fish bowl, morning or evening. Bánh căn is named at the night market, and that page does not say what is in it.

Night-market stalls, from the provincial page: bún chả, chả cá, bánh căn, fried squid, breaded shrimp, ice cream, pomelo chè, sương sa hạt lựu chè, ginseng chè, green-bean chè, glutinous rice balls in syrup, and lotus-seed chè.

Chợ Xóm Mới, 49 Ngô Gia Tự, names bánh canh chả cá, bánh xèo, bún sứa, nem nướng, bún chả cá, bún cá, bún canh, chè, and bánh. Chợ Đầm names bún cá, bún chả cá, and nem, plus the seafood species on that page. Yến sào is the nest product: Hòn Nội on the bureau page, Yến Island on Vietnam Tourism.

spots.name: Nem nướng
spots.note: Grilled pork paste from Ninh Hòa. The provincial page describes skewers, bánh tráng phơi sương, herbs, pickles, fried ram, and a yellow-orange sauce of lean pork, liver, shrimp, sticky rice, and fermented bean. No plate photo.

spots.name: Bún cá Ninh Hòa
spots.note: Fish noodle bowl. Body text: cá thu, cá ngừ, and cá cờ. Caption: cá dầm usually from cá bò and cá ngừ. Broth of fish bone, pineapple, and tomato. Cake from cá đỏ, cá nhồng, and cá thu ảo. Morning and evening. No Nha Trang street is printed.

sections.heading: International dining
paragraphs: These doors are the foreign and chain rooms named on the provincial shopping pages. Vinpearl Harbour names Kohaku Ramen and Nướng Quảng Châu. Vincom Plaza Trần Phú names King BBQ and Hotpot Story. Vincom Plaza Lê Thánh Tôn names Master Beef, Gogi House, Jollibee, Sumo BBQ, Alfresco, Salsa Express, and Uber. Nha Trang Center names Haidilao, KFC, and Texas Chicken. A dish was not invented where the page only prints the sign.

sections.heading: Fine dining
paragraphs: The provincial digital guide prints one steak room it calls cao cấp: Ember Steakhouse at 16A Trần Phú. The plates named on that page are that room’s dishes, not separate restaurants.

spots.name: Ember Steakhouse
spots.note: The provincial page calls this a cao cấp steak room at 16A Trần Phú, phone 0398 537 968. Dishes it names: Ember Signature Tomahawk, Dry-Aged Ribeye, Wagyu Striploin, Surf & Turf Nha Trang, Fire Kissed Oyster, Seafood Grill Platter, and Truffle Mashed Potato. Wine is mentioned. A price was not printed.

sections.heading: Themed dining
paragraphs: Themed here means a room tied to a view, a floor, or a night setting on a page that was opened. Vietnam Tourism names Sailing Club on the beach and Skylight on the 43rd floor of Havana Hotel. Champa Island names Champa 76 for coffee at sunset. Vinpearl Harbour names Sunset Bar, Li’a Cuisine & Mixology Bar, Kasan Beer, and Warning Zone. Wonder Club and The S Hookahs are on that page as late-night rooms. The page does not name food there, so they are not dining entries.

sections.heading: Breakfast
paragraphs: Kubera serves a breakfast buffet for guests at Champa Island. Champa 76 also serves breakfast. Bún cá is also eaten from early morning. A city breakfast street, with a clock, was not printed.

spots.note: The provincial Champa Island page says Nhà hàng Kubera serves the breakfast buffet for guests staying at Champa Island. It sits by the river at 304 đường 2/4.
